description: Send a structured, non-binding product inquiry to the responsible merchant. Use this when inventory is unknown, a buyer needs a supplier answer, or a quote cannot yet be issued. The inquiry stores SKU, quantity, destination, buyer and agent identity and does not create an order or payment.

agent.description: Optional calling-agent identity included in the inquiry audit record.

buyer.description: Buyer contact details required for supplier follow-up.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key reused on retries so the same inquiry is not duplicated.

items.description: One to 50 SKU lines. Use this when inventory is unknown or a supplier answer is needed.

note.description: Optional SKU-specific question for the supplier.

quantity.description: Requested units; must meet the product MOQ.

message.description: Additional non-sensitive instructions or questions for the supplier.

name: submit_inquiry

outputSchema.description: Stored inquiry and supplier notification status.
